name: dev_operation_contract
definition: executable leaf abstraction discovered under dev/. broad enough to represent a command, function, script, or binary while keeping logical taxonomy separate from path identity.

required.key: string; short logical shorthand; human-facing; may collide
required.name: string; human-facing label
required.entry: string; invocation token, function symbol, script name, or binary name

optional.group: string|null; local subgroup inside the component
optional.declared_taxonomy: string|null; raw taxonomy declared in metadata

rules: key is shorthand and may collide
taxonomy is logical meaning, not storage location
script filename does not need to match taxonomy
operation_type is the broad executable class, not the taxonomy
a command view is an alias or pointer to a valid operation object
